# sqlpipe v2.0

sqlpipe v2.0 adds incremental processing and increases Parquet write speed. This release also changes the user response format.

## Breaking API change

The `/v2/users` response replaces the `name` field with `first_name` and `last_name`. The API does not return `name` in version 2. Clients that read `name` require an update.

Update each client to read `first_name` and `last_name`. When a client requires a full name, combine both fields. Test the updated client before you use the version 2 API.

## Incremental processing

The new `--incremental` flag processes new or changed data without a complete reload.

Use this flag for incremental pipeline runs.

## Parquet performance

Parquet writes are 40% faster in sqlpipe v2.0. This improvement reduces the write time for Parquet output.
